# What does one ready-to-use gallon really cost?

> Calculate commercial cleaning chemical cost per ready-to-use gallon, bucket, and job from concentrate dilution and supplier price.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
